### CVE-2011-0167
- Assigner: apple | Published: 2011-03-11 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 35434: WebKit 1.2.x - Local Webpage Cross Domain Information Disclosure (remote/windows, 2011-03-09, verified=1)

The windows functionality in WebKit in Apple Safari before 5.0.4 allows remote attackers to bypass the Same Origin Policy, and force the upload of arbitrary local files from a client computer, via a crafted web site.

### CVE-2011-0180
- Assigner: apple | Published: 2011-03-23 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 35488: Apple Mac OSX 10.6.x - HFS Subsystem Information Disclosure (local/osx, 2011-03-21, verified=1)

Integer overflow in HFS in Apple Mac OS X before 10.6.7 allows local users to read arbitrary (1) HFS, (2) HFS+, or (3) HFS+J files via a crafted F_READBOOTSTRAP ioctl call.

### CVE-2011-0182
- Assigner: apple | Published: 2011-03-23 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 17901: Apple Mac OSX < 10.6.7 - Kernel Panic (Denial of Service) (dos/osx, 2011-09-28, verified=0)

The i386_set_ldt system call in the kernel in Apple Mac OS X before 10.6.7 does not properly handle call gates, which allows local users to gain privileges via vectors involving the creation of a call gate entry.

### CVE-2011-0257
- Assigner: apple | Published: 2011-08-15 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 17777: Apple QuickTime - PICT PnSize Buffer Overflow (Metasploit) (local/windows, 2011-09-03, verified=1)
